component.name: Unrot
component.summary: Five small daily steps to get your attention back

description.p: Unrot turns the five steps from the guide "How to Unrot Your Brain" into a calm daily checklist: a phone curfew, time with no device, writing, exploring a topic, and reading for fun.
There are no streaks. Rest days never count against you. Each step says honestly how strong the evidence behind it is. All data stays on your computer.
Gentle reminders for water, breaks every 35 minutes, eye exercises, lunch, a walk, reading and a focus hour with Do Not Disturb keep working after you close the window.
A Focus tab runs focus sessions and logs distractions. Weekly scores for focus, learning and digital hygiene explain themselves, and a coach suggests one next best action that adapts to you.
